in.other_title: MITRE ATLAS AML.T0094: Delay Execution of LLM Instructions
in.rationale: Delayed execution could be a useful attack pattern to test for, but this source and pack supply no episode showing it occurs in the local population. The technique concerns instructions executed after a later event or interaction, while the population consists of single pre-action decision snapshots, so a single snapshot may not be able to contain the delayed trigger.
